requirements.description: The priority queue must use a deterministic, type-safe tie-breaker for equal-priority messages (comparing message payloads is not safe — payloads can be any type)

All 6 rich comparison methods manually implemented (lines 57-88). __lt__ compares (urgency, _seq) only (lines 57-62). __eq__ compares (urgency == other.urgency and _seq == other._seq) only (lines 69-73). message field has compare=False (line 40) and is NEVER accessed in any comparison. __hash__ consistent with __eq__ (lines 90-91).
